title: New public LiveSpan methods need a NoOpSpan stub and an API inventory entry
answers: I added a method to LiveSpan, why does it fail when tracing is off
which files must list a new span method
NoOpSpan missing method when tracing is disabled
api reference inventory for span methods
body:
Invariant: every public method added to `LiveSpan` must also exist on `NoOpSpan` as a no-op, so callers work when tracing is disabled or a span is not recording.
Enforcement: mlflow/entities/span.py:NoOpSpan.set_description (a `pass` stub) paired with mlflow/entities/span.py:LiveSpan.set_description.
Also list the new method in docs/api_reference/api_inventory.txt, in sorted position among the `mlflow.entities.LiveSpan.*` and `mlflow.entities.NoOpSpan.*` entries; this PR added both `set_description` lines there.
What breaks if skipped: code calling the method raises AttributeError when tracing is off, and the new API is missing from the API reference inventory.
applies: Public methods added to LiveSpan in mlflow/entities/span.py; not for read-only properties.
says: Setting a span description crashes our application whenever tracing is turned off.
Allow updating span descriptions safely even when active trace recording is disabled.
Applications fail with missing method errors on trace spans when disabled in configuration.
Ensure custom span description updates work seamlessly whether tracing is enabled or disabled.
The public documentation is missing the command to set trace span descriptions.
search: Every public method added to LiveSpan in mlflow/entities/span.py must be paired with a no-op stub on NoOpSpan so calls succeed when tracing is disabled or not recording. This requirement applies to public methods such as set_description, but excludes read-only properties. New methods must also be added in sorted alphabetical order to docs/api_reference/api_inventory.txt under both LiveSpan and NoOpSpan entries. Omitting the stub causes AttributeError when tracing is turned off and leaves the method missing from API reference inventory.
